raw:
The error occurs because the function doesn't recognize the straight formed by A-2-3-4-5. The current logic only checks for consecutive values where the difference between max and min is 4, ignoring the special case where Ace can act as a low card. This oversight causes such a hand to be misclassified as High Card instead of Straight.
